blocks.text: A 90-year-old Japanese-Filipino woman who regained her Japanese nationality this year received a passport at the Japanese Embassy in Manila on Friday, saying she hopes to visit her father’s hometown as early as December. Adelaida Kakazu remained in the Philippines after being separated from her Okinawa-born father following World War II. She expressed a desire […]...
